integrity: The algebraic proof, exact rational boundary and independently reconstructed finite checks are given in the included documents and script. Finite tests do not replace the universal proof. The standard matrix-inversion identities and general noisy-leader objective are prior art.
scientific_limitations: Applies to a single exceptional undirected positive edge conductance in an otherwise unit-weight complete graph, exactly q leaders, homogeneous strictly positive finite gain, and equal independent additive white disturbances. It does not establish heterogeneous-gain or multi-edge classifications; independent verification of the literature coverage remains to be undertaken.
title: Optimal noisy leaders on a clique with one exceptional link
